messages:
Alice Chen: heads up — thinking about how Console surfaces automatic fallback decisions (the "Continuity Nudge"). Two quick goals: 1) make reasons obvious (quota vs latency vs model error) and 2) give ops a clear audit trail + an easy escape hatch. Thoughts? :thinking:

Diego Morales: agree. we should standardize reason codes (e.g. quota_exhausted, latency_slo, model_error, runtime_oom). show a tiny badge next to request rows and in the route history. add an 'oscillation guard' state so UX can show when we suppressed repeated flip-flops. :eyes:

Nina Patel: telemetry needs: fallback rate per-route (last 24h), p50/p95 pre/post fallback, cost delta per 10k reqs, and a timeline of events with model version + node id snapshot. audit events should include full reason code and request sample id. exportable CSV/JSON.

Samir Rao: implementation note — runtime can attach headers so Console doesn't need to infer: `X-RW-Fallback: latency_slo` and `X-RW-Fallback-Model: redwood/gptq-6b` and `X-RW-Fallback-ReasonCode: 0x12` (opaque code). That lets Console show exact cause and model used. also propose a dry-run simulator that replays recent traffic against fallback rules and reports how many would have fallen back.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: fallback-policy-sim v0.7 -> 3 nodes (us-west) :zap:

Maya Singh: ux idea: show a subtle banner "Continuity nudge: some requests are being routed to a fallback to preserve continuity" with a CTA "Show why". clicking opens a modal with: reason timeline, sample request/response, tokens saved estimate, latency delta, and two actions: [Pause auto-fallback] [Force original model for next 100 requests].

Alice Chen: important: when we show "tokens saved" we must be explicit about methodology. users shouldn't be surprised if enabling fallback increases cost for some workloads. include a small tooltip: "Estimate based on avg tokens and model per-token cost".

Diego Morales: edge cases to design for: 1) fallback repeatedly triggers then original model recovers -> oscillation; 2) fallback model itself errors -> chained fallback; 3) quota-driven fallback that just shifts cost to another pool. need circuit-breaker TTLs and backoff policies surfaced.

Nina Patel: retention & access: store full audit events for 90 days by default; make full traces gated by RBAC (only SRE/platform-admin can view raw request samples). also add quick links from audit to traces in tracing system.

Samir Rao: sample policy snippet (for console to display in human form):
```json
{
  "route": "/chat",
  "fallbacks": [
    {"when": "latency_p95 > 800ms", "action": "route_to", "model": "redwood/gptq-6b", "oscillation_guard": {"ttl_s": 300}},
    {"when": "quota_remaining < 10%", "action": "route_to", "model": "redwood/compact-1.3b", "require_audit": true}
  ],
  "dry_run": false
}
```

Maya Singh: love the JSON. UI should allow toggling `dry_run` and simulate on historical window. show projected fallback count and estimated token delta before you push.

Diego Morales: question for product: should `require_audit` be on by default for quota-driven fallbacks? Might blow up logs. maybe default false and warn about it in modal; let enterprise orgs opt-in to require audit.

Alice Chen: product preference: default false, but surface a one-click opt-in per-route and a tenant-level policy. route-level first, tenant override. also add an "explain" panel that translates reason codes to plain english and shows which nodes handled the request.

Samir Rao: ops escape hatches: add an ephemeral toggle in Console "disable auto-fallback for 10m" that writes a short-lived policy override. that helps on P1s. and include an API call for programmatic overrides.

Nina Patel: for SLO dashboards add a small heatmap: rows=routes, cols=hours -> cell intensity = fallback-rate. clicking cell opens list of sample events. this helps spot regression windows.

Alice Chen: final checklist for UX deliverable: - compact badge + banner - "Show why" modal with timeline + sample + tokens/latency deltas - dry-run simulator in policy editor - one-click pause & force-original - RBAC-protected audit export - oscillation guard visualizations - clear cost methodology tooltip

Diego Morales: I'll draft the reason-code enum and telemetry schema. Samir can you expose the headers + dry-run endpoint? Nina will scoping retention + RBAC. Maya/Alice will sketch the modal.

Samir Rao: yes i'll add headers and a new /policies/simulate endpoint; will put a small prototype in the canary.

deploy-bot: canary alert: fallback-policy-sim v0.7 reported 2.8% fallback rate on /chat in last 30m

Maya Singh: nice — can we get a quick mock by EOD tomorrow so we can validate wording around "tokens saved"? :pray:

Alice Chen: thanks all — syncing with Maya tomorrow 10am PT. adding action items to the ticket. :thumbsup:
